We had a similar situation in South Australia when a 3 metre Great White we'd tagged with a few sensors plunged depth and spiked in temperature.

The temperature range however did match up with the digestive tract of a much larger shark, based on the speed and depth plunge they were estimating a shark of around 8-11 metres long, an 11m would be a great deal larger than most previous analysis of the upper size limit of Great Whites.
